orchestrator.description: Oversees end-to-end multi-agent execution, cross-layer dependency ordering, and architectural coherence across database, backend, web, and mobile.

agents.name: Database Architect
responsibilities: Relational schema modeling and constraints (SQLAlchemy 2.0 & PostgreSQL)
PostgreSQL Row Level Security (RLS) policies for Supabase
Migration script authoring and execution verification
Connection pool tuning (asyncpg, pool_size, max_overflow, pool_recycle, pool_pre_ping)
Query indexing strategies, composite indices, and uniqueness enforcement

agents.name: Backend Engineer
responsibilities: FastAPI REST endpoints and APIRouter modular routing
Pydantic v2 request/response schemas and payload validation
Authentication mechanisms (JWT, Argon2, Google OAuth, OTP security)
Recommendation graph engine (co-occurrence & collaborative filtering)
Prefix Trie autocomplete and search suggestion algorithms
SlowAPI rate limiting, GZip middleware, CORS configuration
Unit and integration test suites execution and pass guarantees

agents.name: Web Engineer
responsibilities: React 19 + TypeScript + Vite modern web application components
Web Audio API 10-band parametric equalizer and canvas visualizer
State management via React Contexts (AudioContext, AuthContext, ThemeContext)
Backend API client consumption and type alignment
HTML5 CacheStorage offline audio blob caching and storage quota meter
Responsive desktop and tablet layouts with TailwindCSS
Zero TypeScript compiler errors (`tsc --noEmit` pass)

agents.name: Mobile Engineer
responsibilities: Flutter 3.x native Android application (SDK 36, Java 17)
Clean Architecture domain layers (TrackEntity, CatalogRepository, SyncManager)
Background audio engine integration (just_audio + audio_service)
5-Minute battery wakelock guard and AudioSession lifecycle teardown
Local offline storage with Hive boxes and automatic cache eviction
Synchronized LRC lyrics renderer with millisecond offset controls
Native Android 5-band equalizer bound to audio session ID
Full Flutter test suite execution and pass guarantees
